fato_historico: 1976: The Çaldıran–Muradiye earthquake in eastern Turkey kills between 4,000 and 5,000 people.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to reflect on the strength that blooms from life's challenges. Much like the earth itself that can shake and shift, your spirit holds a profound capacity to rebuild and flourish. It is a good time to ground yourself, cherish your connections, and nurture the warmth you bring to the world around you.
frase_do_dia: Even after the deepest shifts, your inner light continues to guide the way home.
significado_numero: Represents a powerful bridge between your dreams and your current reality.
conselho: Consider extending an extra hand of kindness to someone who needs support today.
